criterion: Installation, first boot provisioning, signed updates and rollback are produced from the same canonical source tree that runs MiniTZ; no dev/install/release source split exists and restart preserves task/memory/resource continuity.
accepted_criteria: Installation, first boot provisioning, signed updates and rollback are produced from the same canonical source tree that runs MiniTZ; no dev/install/release source split exists and restart preserves task/memory/resource continuity.

focused_tests.command: pytest -q tests/test_minitz_source_release.py tests/test_minitz_boot_image.py tests/test_minitz_os_sandbox.py tests/test_minitz_lifecycle.py tests/test_minitz_operator_surface.py tests/test_unify04_continuity.py tests/test_minitz_data_residency.py tests/test_minitz_secret_boundary.py

source_identity.canonical_source: src/ and ops/ under the one MiniTZ repository

assertions: first-boot task, memory and resource state survives two signed updates
restart recovery verifies the active source and continuity digest
rollback activates the prior verified source generation
wrong signing key is rejected before activation

negative_controls: release packaging excludes private state and raw credential material
signed update verification occurs before installation activation
no lifecycle transition is invoked by the install/update/recovery APIs
no second source tree or task authority is created
